label: The first piece of an n't contraction, cut before the apostrophe (the 'didn' of didn't, 'shouldn' of shouldn't, also 'won' of won't), and the word 'according' before 'to', anywhere in a sentence; more weakly, the space before a number the tokenizer splits into digits (a year like 1987) and the first digit of a 'mid-19xx' decade. Quiet on spelled-out 'not' or 'never', on 'Don' as a name, on 'dont' without an apostrophe and on other fixed pairs ('due to', 'each other'); ordinary text sits at a low background of about 0.3.
